HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Who Is It? is a classic two-player guessing game where you use yes or no questions to identify your opponent's mystery character.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Each player selects a mystery character.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Players take turns asking yes or no questions to eliminate characters.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: The first player to correctly guess their opponent's character wins!
